secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_URL
secrets.description: Your Supabase project URL (https://<ref>.supabase.co) from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API. Required — the app uses Supabase for auth + Postgres + RLS.

secrets.name: NEXT_PUBLIC_SUPABASE_ANON_KEY
secrets.description: Your Supabase anon/public API key from Supabase Dashboard → Project Settings → API. Required — used by both browser and server Supabase clients.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_CLOUD_NAME
secrets.description: Cloudinary cloud name (Cloudinary Console). Optional — only needed for the KTP/foto upload API routes.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_KEY
secrets.description: Cloudinary API key (Cloudinary Console). Optional — only needed for the KTP/foto upload API routes.

secrets.name: CLOUDINARY_API_SECRET
secrets.description: Cloudinary API secret (Cloudinary Console). Optional — only needed for the KTP/foto upload API routes.

secrets.name: OCR_SPACE_API_KEY
secrets.description: OCR.space API key (https://ocr.space/ocrapi). Optional — only needed for the KTP OCR (scan KTP) feature.
